title: Section 24 HMA — Maintenance pendente lite and expenses of proceedings

content.overview: Section 24 empowers the court, in any proceeding under the Act, to order the respondent to pay the petitioner maintenance pendente lite and such expenses of the proceeding as appear reasonable if it appears that the petitioner has no independent income sufficient for support and the necessary expenses of the proceeding.
content.study: Either spouse may apply; the focus is relative financial capacity and necessity during the litigation, not final property division. Quantum is discretionary and fact-sensitive. Distinguish from permanent alimony and maintenance under section 25, which usually follows or accompanies a decree under the Act. Pair with sections 9, 13, and 13B as the host proceedings.
